reason: My counter is busy at lunch, and I'm not going to have my staff tap +1 on a phone every time someone says a code. Even if it's free during the pilot, I'd rather put ₹5,000 into a Meta boost or a Swiggy ad where I can see the numbers without doing anything.
objection: I don't trust influencers to bring paying customers, and keeping count at the till is extra work for me. Half the time staff will forget to tap, so the cost-per-customer number won't be right anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If the code could be redeemed through my billing/POS or on Swiggy/Zomato so counting happened automatically, and if I saw a nearby café's real numbers showing a creator brought more customers per rupee than my boosts.
